'''Gelrex''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[General/Legends|general]] fighting for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Battle of Ilum]]. He was approached by personnel of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] with an offer to join them.
